title: Asking an agent for a video

beats.say: You ask your agent in plain words.

do.user: make a demo video of the new settings page

beats.say: It says what it will do, checks a storyboard, then records.

do.agent: I'll write a script, check a storyboard frame by frame, then record it.

beats.say: And it hands you a link to review the video.

do.agent: Done. Review it with `demo url settings`, then tell me what to change.
